name: opencode status
author: folken
description: Shows an opencode icon in the topbar while opencode is working, with an attention animation when it needs input. Notifications are sent by the companion opencode plugin.

barWidget.description: opencode activity indicator: visible only while working or waiting for input

schema.label: Working color
schema.description: Line color while opencode is working. Hex like #4ade80.

schema.label: Needs-input color
schema.description: Line color the blink alternates to while opencode waits for input. Hex like #ef5350.

schema.label: Done/error color
schema.description: Line color for the transient done/error flash. Empty follows the theme foreground.
